data.name: The Blanco
data.description: A round dining table featuring a clean hardwood top paired with a sculptural curved metal pedestal base. The open pedestal design provides generous legroom while giving the Blanco a modern Hill Country feel.

data.name: The Pedernales
data.description: A statement trestle table featuring substantial curved wood supports, a center stretcher, and traditional architectural detailing. The Pedernales blends old-world craftsmanship with the warmth and character of a Texas Hill Country home.

data.name: The San Marcos
data.description: A round dining table built around a sculptural wood pedestal with graceful curved supports. The San Marcos offers the intimacy of a round table with a refined base that gives the design presence from every angle.
data.imageAlt: The San Marcos semi-custom dining table

data.name: The Guadalupe
data.description: A refined trestle table featuring sweeping curved supports and a substantial center pedestal design. The Guadalupe combines traditional craftsmanship with softer architectural lines for a table that feels equally at home in classic or transitional spaces.

data.name: The Frio
data.description: A straightforward four-leg dining table inspired by the simplicity of traditional farmhouse furniture. Clean lines, solid wood construction, and an understated design make the Frio an approachable table built for everyday family life.

data.name: The Llano
data.description: A clean, contemporary dining table pairing a solid hardwood top with black powder-coated trapezoid steel legs. The Llano brings together natural wood and metal for a versatile design with a distinctly modern Texas character.

data.name: The Brazos
data.description: A substantial trestle table defined by bold X-shaped supports and a connecting center stretcher. The Brazos has a strong architectural presence while maintaining the warmth and character of a handcrafted hardwood dining table.

data.name: The Colorado
data.description: A clean four-leg dining table with square legs and a traditional apron construction. Simple proportions and restrained detailing allow the hardwood to take center stage, making the Colorado one of the most versatile designs in the collection.

data.collectionIntroduction: Named for the rivers that run through Central Texas, each table in the Hill Country Collection is designed to bring families back to the table and built to become part of the home for years to come.
data.homeIntroduction: The slow Sunday mornings. The extra chair at Thanksgiving. The conversations that carry on long after.
data.homeOffering: Begin with a semi-custom design from the Hill Country Collection, or bring Jeremy an idea for a completely custom piece. Every table is made in Buda from solid hardwood and shaped around your home.
data.collectionGuidance: Choose a design, then tailor the dimensions, hardwood, base finish, and details to your home.
data.makerIntroduction: A local craftsman, a love of solid hardwood, and furniture built around the moments that make a house a home.
makerBiography: Woodworking began as a hobby years ago. After nearly twenty years in banking, an unexpected career change gave me the opportunity to turn something I loved into something much bigger.

A table is where homework happens, extra chairs get squeezed in for the holidays, and family stories collect. That is why I build each piece one at a time in Buda, with solid hardwood and the care to make it part of your home for years to come.
From the first conversation to the final finish, you work directly with me. Your questions, ideas, and the details of your home all have a place in the process.

craftsmanship.introduction: The materials, proven methods, and careful decisions behind furniture made for everyday life.
craftsmanship.materials: The grain, color, and natural variation of real hardwood are part of the design. Each board brings something individual to the finished piece.
craftsmanship.choosingWood: Choosing a wood is about more than a color. It is about the atmosphere you want to create, and the materials you want to live with.

process.introduction: A clear, collaborative path from the first conversation to a finished piece made for your home.
process.approach: You work directly with Jeremy from the first conversation through the final details, with clear decisions around design, budget, timing, and delivery.
process.offering: Start with a Hill Country Collection design for a semi-custom table, or bring your own idea for a completely custom piece. You and Jeremy shape the dimensions, wood, and details around your home.

investment.introduction: Standard prices make it easier to begin. Jeremy confirms every customization, timeline, and delivery detail before the work starts.

contact.introduction: A finished idea or a first thought. Wherever you are, a direct conversation with Jeremy is the next step.
contact.inquiryGuidance: No need to know your wood species or exact dimensions yet. Share your home, how you gather, and what you would love to create.

pricing.upgrade: Matching natural-wood bases are available as an upgrade
pricing.custom: Larger sizes, premium hardwood species, and other customizations are priced separately.

faqs.question: What is included in standard pricing?
faqs.answer: Standard pricing includes solid-hardwood construction in red oak or pecan. Rectangular tables are 36" × 72" × 1.25" thick top; round tables are 42" diameter × 1.25" thick top. Wood bases are painted as standard.

faqs.question: Can I choose a natural-wood base?
faqs.answer: Yes. A matching natural-wood base is available as an upgrade on applicable designs. Jeremy will confirm the wood, finish, and final price with you.

faqs.question: Can Jeremy build something outside the collection?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Hill Country Collection offers semi-custom starting points, while a completely custom commission can begin with a room, a sketch, a saved photograph, or an original idea.

faqs.question: How long does a custom piece take?
faqs.answer: Every piece is made to order. Lead times vary with the design and Jeremy’s current workshop schedule; you will receive a current estimate during your consultation.

faqs.question: Is my piece covered by a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes. J. K. Oliver Woodworks stands behind its craftsmanship with a one-year warranty. Full coverage, care requirements, and claim details are provided in the written warranty and Terms and Conditions before your project begins.

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: Delivery details are coordinated as part of your project. J. K. Oliver Woodworks is based in Buda and serves Central Texas.
